messages.author: b2aa4256c4ad2f50
messages.subject: Can't download session data
parts:
Hi Folks,

I'm trying to download the R code, but instead the browser gives me an error page "file no found (http://127.0.0.1:4984/session/5e8e4b705d2e0aa8318dbba36852f4d3/download/dlRMD?w=.)". The R console shows the message: "Warning: Error in : pandoc version 1.12.3 or higher is required and was not found (see the help page ?rmarkdown::pandoc_available).
  [No stack trace available]". I have installed pandoc but the error persists.

Thank you for your help

messages.author: d73691b565754184
messages.subject: Re: Can't download session data
parts:
Hi João,

I think there is a problem of communication between RStudio and pandoc. Please, run the following lines and let me know their results.
>Sys.getenv("RSTUDIO_PANDOC")
>rmarkdown::pandoc_version()
>rmarkdown::pandoc_available()

I hope that with this information, we can find a solution for your problem.

Best,
Gonzalo
